q: 奶奶从小就___包饺子，包得又快又好。
en: Grandma has known how to make dumplings since she was little, and she makes them quickly and well.

q: 我爸爸没学过英语，所以不___说英语。
en: My dad never studied English, so he can't speak it.

q: 我妈妈___做蛋糕，生日蛋糕都是她自己做的。
en: My mum knows how to bake cakes; all the birthday cakes are ones she made herself.

q: 我女儿四岁了，还不___自己系鞋带。
en: My daughter is four and doesn't know how to tie her own shoelaces yet.

q: 外婆不___用智能手机，每次都要我帮她发信息。
en: Grandma doesn't know how to use a smartphone; she always needs me to send messages for her.

q: 妈妈说她小时候没人教她游泳，所以到现在还不___游。
en: Mum says nobody taught her to swim as a child, so even now she can't swim.

q: 我爷爷小时候没上过学，不___写字，只好请邻居帮他写信。
en: My grandpa never went to school as a child, so he can't write and has to ask a neighbour to write letters for him.

q: 我的朋友在国外长大，从来不___用筷子，所以我们请他吃饭的时候给他拿了刀叉。
en: My friend grew up abroad and has never known how to use chopsticks, so when we had him over for dinner we gave him a knife and fork.

q: 你看，云越来越多，一会儿一定___下雨。
en: Look, the clouds are gathering; it is sure to rain in a while.

q: 别担心，这只小狗不___咬你，它很乖。
en: Don't worry, this puppy won't bite you; it is very well behaved.

q: 你不吃早饭，上课的时候___很饿。
en: If you skip breakfast, you'll be very hungry in class.

q: 你不穿外套就出门，肯定___感冒。
en: Going out without a coat, you're sure to catch a cold.

q: 妈妈看到你的成绩，一定___生气。
en: Mum surely won't be angry when she sees your grades.

q: 你把牛奶放在外面，晚上就___坏。
en: If you leave the milk out, it will go bad by tonight.

q: 孩子长得这么快，这件衣服明年就___小了。
en: Kids grow so fast; this piece of clothing will be too small next year.

q: 要是价钱一直不降，来买东西的客人就___越来越少。
en: If the prices never come down, fewer and fewer customers will come to shop.

q: 商店晚上八点关门，你现在才去，肯定___买不到新鲜的菜了。
en: The shop closes at eight; if you only go now, you surely won't be able to buy fresh vegetables.

q: 别担心，这家店的东西不___很贵的。
en: Don't worry, the things in this shop won't be very expensive.

q: 你放心，奶奶一定___喜欢这件新衣服的。
en: Don't worry, Grandma will definitely like this new outfit.

q: 放心吧，我不___忘记你的生日的。
en: Rest assured, I won't forget your birthday.

q: 你放心，店里的人不___多收你的钱的。
en: Don't worry, the shop staff won't overcharge you.

q: 你要是把新手机弄丢了，爸爸一定不___高兴的。
en: If you lose your new phone, Dad will definitely be unhappy.

q: 买这么多没用的东西，妈妈回来看到，一定___骂你的。
en: If Mum comes back and sees you bought so many useless things, she'll definitely scold you.

q: 我的腿很疼，现在不___走路。
en: My leg hurts a lot; I can't walk right now.

q: 现在是晚上十二点，商店都关门了，我们不___买东西了。
en: It's midnight and the shops are all closed, so we can't buy anything now.

q: 我手机没电了，___打电话了。
en: My phone is dead, so I can't make calls.

q: 我会开车，可是今天喝了酒，所以不___开。
en: I can drive, but I've been drinking today, so I can't.

q: 电脑坏了，我现在不___上网。
en: The computer is broken, so I can't get online right now.

q: 我会做饭，可是今天煤气坏了，不___做饭。
en: I can cook, but the gas is broken today, so I can't cook.

q: 我的钱包不见了，我现在不___买东西。
en: My wallet is missing, so I can't buy anything right now.

q: 爷爷的腿好了，已经___自己上楼了。
en: Grandpa's leg has healed, and he can go upstairs by himself again.

q: 我们昨天买的电视机坏了，所以今天不___看电视了，只好看手机。
en: The TV we bought yesterday broke, so we can't watch TV today and have to watch on our phones.

q: 因为客厅的灯坏了，晚上孩子不___在客厅写作业，只能去爸爸的房间写。
en: Because the living-room light is broken, the child can't do homework there in the evening and has to use Dad's room.

q: 我爸爸一顿___吃三碗米饭。
en: My dad can eat three bowls of rice in one meal.

q: 这个箱子很大，___放二十本书。
en: This box is big; it can hold twenty books.

q: 这辆小汽车只___坐四个人，我们六个人坐不下。
en: This little car can only seat four people; the six of us don't fit.

q: 她一分钟___打一百个字，比我快多了。
en: She can type a hundred characters a minute, much faster than me.

q: 我家的小狗很大，一次___吃两斤肉。
en: Our dog is big; it can eat a kilo of meat at a time.

q: 这家超市每天___卖三千个面包，生意特别好。
en: This supermarket can sell three thousand loaves of bread a day; business is excellent.

q: 奶奶年纪这么大了，每天还___走五公里，身体真好。
en: Grandma is so old, yet she can still walk five kilometres every day; her health is wonderful.

q: 这个冰箱不太大，一次最多___放二十瓶牛奶，再多就放不下了。
en: This fridge isn't very big; it can hold at most twenty bottles of milk at a time, and more won't fit.

q: 老师，我___用一下你的笔吗？
en: Teacher, may I use your pen for a moment?

q: 妈妈，我___吃一个冰淇淋吗？
en: Mum, may I have an ice cream?

q: 这家商店里___拍照，你拍吧。
en: Photos are allowed in this shop, go ahead and take one.

q: 这家商店的衣服___试穿，不满意也可以不买。
en: You can try the clothes on in this shop, and you needn't buy if you're not happy.

q: 要是你觉得太贵，你___去旁边那家看看。
en: If you think it's too expensive, you could go and have a look at the shop next door.

q: 这个周末你要是没事，___来我家吃饭。
en: If you're free this weekend, you can come to my place for dinner.

q: 如果你觉得网上买东西不放心，也___先去商店看看，再决定买不买。
en: If you don't feel safe buying online, you could also go and look in a shop first and then decide.

q: 买东西的时候，如果觉得价钱太贵，你___和老板商量一下，说不定能便宜一点儿。
en: When shopping, if the price seems too high, you can talk it over with the owner; it might get cheaper.

q: 妈妈，我可以买这个玩具吗？——___，你已经有很多玩具了。
en: Mum, may I buy this toy? -- No, you already have lots of toys.

q: 我明天要去医院，所以___来上课。
en: I have to go to the hospital tomorrow, so I can't come to class.

q: 我的钱不够，今天___买这个包了。
en: I don't have enough money, so I can't buy this bag today.

q: 医院里面___大声说话，别人在休息。
en: You may not talk loudly inside the hospital; others are resting.

q: 我问姐姐可不可以用她的电脑，姐姐说：“对不起，现在___，我要写作业。”
en: I asked my sister if I could use her computer, and she said, "Sorry, not right now; I need to do my homework."

q: 没学过英语的人，当然___说英语。
en: Of course someone who has never studied English can't speak it.

q: 你放心，这家店的老板人很好，___骗你的。
en: Don't worry, the owner of this shop is a good man; he won't cheat you.

q: 妈妈说，吃饭的时候___看手机，要专心吃饭。
en: Mum says you may not look at your phone while eating; you have to focus on the meal.

q: 我问老板可不可以多拿一份，他说___，每个人只能拿一份。
en: I asked the boss if I could take an extra portion, and he said no; everyone can only take one.

q: 我妈妈很___做饭，大家都爱吃她做的菜。
en: My mum is really good at cooking; everyone loves her food.

q: 我弟弟很___吃，一个人吃了一只鸡。
en: My little brother can really eat; he ate a whole chicken by himself.

q: 她很___买东西，同样的东西总是买得比别人便宜。
en: She is very good at shopping; she always gets the same things cheaper than others.

q: 这只小狗真___吃，一下子吃了两斤肉。
en: This puppy can really eat; it ate a kilo of meat in one go.

q: 老板很___说话，我本来只想看看，最后还是买了两件。
en: The owner is very good with words; I only meant to look but ended up buying two items.

q: 他太太很___做生意，同样的东西，她总能卖得比别人贵。
en: His wife is very good at business; she can always sell the same goods for more than others.

q: 你这个孩子真___说，一个人说了一个小时都不累。
en: You really can talk, child; you talked for a whole hour on your own without getting tired.
